text: どうも　うえの　かいに　まよえる　たましいを　かんじる

structure.jp: まよえる　たましいを

patterns.name: 〜る (classical ongoing state)
patterns.span: まよえる　たましい
patterns.explanation: This is an old literary ending, not 'can be lost': まよえる means 'that is wandering lost' and describes the thing after it. まよえる　たましい = 'lost souls'.

patterns.name: どうも〜
patterns.span: どうも　うえの　かいに　まよえる　たましいを　かんじる
patterns.explanation: どうも at the start says you can't say exactly why, but it seems so. どうも ... かんじる = 'somehow I sense'.
